skills.label: Champion kit
skills.desc: A playbook for engineers advocating Claude Code internally: what to share, how to answer questions, and how to grow adoption on your team.

skills.label: Communications kit
skills.desc: Launch announcements, drip-campaign messages, and FAQ responses for rolling Claude Code out to your engineering organization.

skills.label: Claude apps gateway configuration
skills.desc: Reference for every gateway.yaml option: listener and TLS, OIDC, session, Postgres store, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry upstreams, model routing, managed policies, and telemetry.

skills.label: Claude apps gateway deployment and operations
skills.desc: Register the gateway with your IdP, build the container, deploy on Kubernetes or Cloud Run, and operate it: health checks, secret rotation, upgrades, and security.

skills.label: Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry
skills.desc: Run Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry behind a self-hosted gateway with SSO sign-in, per-group model access, and OTLP telemetry.

skills.label: Claude apps gateway spend limits
skills.desc: Cap each developer's spend through the Claude apps gateway by day, week, or month. Set limits with an Admin API and the gateway enforces them live on every request.

skills.label: Deploy Claude apps gateway on AWS
skills.desc: A worked example of running Claude apps gateway on AWS: ECS Fargate or EKS, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, AWS Secrets Manager, and IAM-role auth to Amazon Bedrock.

skills.label: Deploy Claude apps gateway on Google Cloud
skills.desc: A worked example of running Claude apps gateway on Google Cloud: Cloud Run or GKE, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, and service-account auth to Google Cloud's Agent Platform.

skills.label: Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock, including setup, IAM configuration, and troubleshooting.

skills.label: Claude Code on Claude Platform on AWS
skills.desc: Configure Claude Code to use the Anthropic-operated Claude API with AWS authentication, IAM access control, and AWS Marketplace billing.

skills.label: Claude Code on Google Cloud's Agent Platform
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Google Cloud's Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI, including setup, IAM configuration, and troubleshooting.

skills.label: Claude Code on Microsoft Foundry
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Microsoft Foundry, including setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.

skills.label: Development containers
skills.desc: Run Claude Code inside a dev container for consistent, isolated environments across your team.

skills.label: Enterprise deployment overview
skills.desc: Learn how Claude Code can integrate with various third-party services and infrastructure to meet enterprise deployment requirements.

skills.label: Enterprise network configuration
skills.desc: Configure Claude Code for enterprise environments with proxy servers, custom Certificate Authorities (CA), and mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) authentication.

skills.label: Feature availability
skills.desc: Compare which Claude Code features work on each Anthropic subscription plan, the Anthropic Console, and cloud providers such as Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud.

skills.label: Run Claude Code behind a corporate launcher
skills.desc: Route the processes Claude Code starts from its own binary, including the background service and every agent view session, through a required launcher with CLAUDECODEPROCESSWRAPPER or the processWrapper setting.

skills.label: Run Claude Code through a gateway
skills.desc: Route Claude Code through a self-hosted gateway for centralized credentials, usage tracking, and cost controls. Covers the architecture, Anthropic's Claude apps gateway, and using other gateway products.

skills.label: Claude Code gateway compatibility guide
skills.desc: Keep an LLM gateway compatible with Claude Code: the endpoints it calls, the headers and body fields to forward, and what breaks when they're stripped.

skills.label: Connect Claude Code to an LLM gateway
skills.desc: Point Claude Code at your organization's LLM gateway. Check whether your admin already configured it, or set the base URL and credential yourself, then verify the connection and fix gateway errors.

skills.label: Other LLM gateways
skills.desc: Route Claude Code through an LLM gateway your organization already runs. Covers connecting Claude Code to a gateway, rolling one out for your organization, and what Claude Code sends to a gateway.

skills.label: Roll out an LLM gateway for your organization
skills.desc: Deploy a gateway product for Claude Code: configure it to forward what Claude Code sends, issue developer credentials, distribute the configuration through managed settings, and verify the rollout.

skills.label: Data usage
skills.desc: Learn about Anthropic's data usage policies for Claude

skills.label: Security
skills.desc: Learn about Claude Code's security safeguards and best practices for safe usage.

skills.label: Set up Claude Code (local mode) for a HIPAA-ready organization
skills.desc: Prepare developers' computers to run Claude Code (local mode) under the HIPAA configuration. Covers versions, network access, managed settings, and local data.

skills.label: Zero data retention
skills.desc: Learn about Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for Claude Code, available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise, including scope, disabled features, and how to request enablement.

skills.label: Advanced setup
skills.desc: System requirements, platform-specific installation, version management, and uninstallation for Claude Code.

skills.label: Authentication
skills.desc: Log in to Claude Code and configure authentication for individuals, teams, and organizations.

skills.label: Configure auto mode
skills.desc: Tell the auto mode classifier which repos, buckets, and domains your organization trusts, set your own block and allow rules, and inspect your config.

skills.label: Configure server-managed settings
skills.desc: Centrally configure Claude Code for your organization through server-delivered settings, without requiring device management infrastructure.

skills.label: Control MCP server access for your organization
skills.desc: Restrict which MCP servers users can add or connect to, or provide servers to every user, with managed configuration files, managed settings, allowlists, and denylists.

skills.label: Deploy managed settings
skills.desc: Deploy managed settings to every developer's machine: delivery mechanisms per OS, how Claude Code combines managed sources, and how to verify enforcement.

skills.label: Set up Claude Code for your organization
skills.desc: A decision map for administrators deploying Claude Code, covering API providers, managed settings, policy enforcement, usage monitoring, and data handling.

skills.label: Manage costs effectively
skills.desc: Track token usage, set team spend limits, and reduce Claude Code costs with context management, model selection, extended thinking settings, and preprocessing hooks.

skills.label: Monitoring
skills.desc: Learn how to enable and configure OpenTelemetry for Claude Code.

skills.label: Track team usage with analytics
skills.desc: View Claude Code usage metrics, track adoption, and measure engineering velocity in the analytics dashboard.
